subject: Co-sell onboarding: sponsorship fund, demo credits, and clawback exception request
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightstack.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@brightstack.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell kickoff & sponsorship ask

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. BrightStack is excited about embedding Redwood for our managed connector that we demo at enterprise shows. Before we commit to a pilot, procurement asked whether Redwood will contribute a modest sponsorship fund to cover demo credits + a joint proof-of-concept (PoC) credit pool.

Key items they asked me to confirm: 
- Amount of sponsor/marketing fund available for partner-led demos (one-time or run-rate)
- Demo credit cadence (how credits are consumed and expiration)
- Whether Redwood will make an exception to the standard 12-month clawback for credits applied to early-stage pilots (procurement wants a 6-month clawback window)

I can share a rough partner profile and expected ARR from the pilot if that helps. Can your team advise who handles partner sponsorships and whether a clawback exception is possible for strategic integrations?

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, BrightStack Labs
elena@brightstack.com
+1 415-555-0198

--
BrightStack Labs | Fast, auditable integrations for regulated finance teams

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightstack.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell kickoff & sponsorship ask

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and context. Short answers up front: yes, we have a partner demo credit pool and we can support a one-time sponsorship for pilot/demos; the clawback term is normally 12 months but we can consider a 6-month exception for strategic ISV pilots on a case-by-case basis.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Camila (partner ops) will draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) that includes the credit schedule and milestone triggers.
2) Ben (sales lead) will map expected ARR and pilot success criteria — that will help justify a shorter clawback.
3) If procurement requires contract language, we'll coordinate with your contracts team for a tailored SOW amendment.

Camila / Ben — can you take point on the MAP and a recommended sponsor amount (range), and flag any compliance or billing implications? I can escalate for approval if we need to make a formal exception to clawback policy.

Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Commercial Partnerships | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightstack.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP + proposed sponsor schedule for BrightStack pilot

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is a short MAP and a proposed sponsor schedule (attached as partner_credit_schedule.xlsx). Highlights: 
- One-time demo & PoC pool: $12k in credits, valid for 9 months from activation.
- Consumption model: credits applied at time of provisioning; BrightStack will notify Redwood when demos convert to named accounts.
- Proposed clawback: 6 months contingent on hitting milestone A (first production deployment) within 90 days of pilot start. If milestone A is missed, standard 12-month clawback applies.

Rationale: the 9-month credit window balances runway for a partner-led sales cycle with Redwood's accounting and fraud controls. The conditional 6-month clawback provides the flexibility procurement asked for but keeps an incentive to progress quickly.

A few items for your contracts team to confirm: whether softened clawback needs explicit SOW language or if a signed MAP + SOW addendum is sufficient. Also flagging billing: we will reserve credits at activation and expense them pro rata over the 9 months for internal accounting.

Elena — if that looks directionally OK, Ben / Lauren and I can prepare the SOW addendum for signatures and loop in your contracts alias.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Partner Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightstack.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@brightstack.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + proposed sponsor schedule for BrightStack pilot

Camila, Markus —

This is great and already much easier than most vendor conversations. Quick clarifications from procurement before we sign: 
- Could we standardize an "early-conversion" credit refund rule? If a demo converts to a paid account inside 60 days, can any unused credits be credited toward first invoice rather than subject to clawback? Procurement prefers credit-to-invoice routing when conversions are rapid.
- On the 9-month window: would Redwood be open to a 12-month expiration if BrightStack commits to two joint events (one field webinar and one trade demo) during that period?

If those two small changes are doable we can route the MAP internally and get back to you with a signed SOW next week.

Thanks — Elena

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightstack.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, contracts@brightstack.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + proposed sponsor schedule for BrightStack pilot

Elena —

Love the pragmatic asks. We can do both: 
1) Early-conversion routing: if a demo converts to a paid account inside 60 days, any unused credits will be applied as a credit toward the first paid invoice (no clawback). We'll codify this in the SOW addendum.
2) Event-conditional extension: Redwood will extend credit expiration from 9 to 12 months if BrightStack commits to and delivers two co-marketing activities (one field webinar + one trade demo) within the 12-month window. We will include a simple reporting clause to verify event delivery.

Camila / Contracts — please update the SOW addendum and redline accordingly. Once the redline is back I can push for executive sign-off on the conditional clawback exception.

Markus — happy to take the approvals path if needed.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
